headline: Puravankara allots non-convertible debentures worth Rs 25 crore
hook: Capital raise completed via private debt
summary: Puravankara Limited has completed the allotment of 250 unlisted, unrated, senior, secured, redeemable, non-convertible debentures aggregating to Rs 25 crore. This issuance represents the fourth and final tranche of the company's private placement offering. Each debenture carries a face value of Rs 10,00,000. Retail investors should note this routine fundraising activity as part of the company's capital management strategy.
why_it_matters: Routine debt fundraising has negligible impact on retail share prices.
